name: W Amman
positioning: A W hotel in Amman's Al Abdali district, entered through a canyon walk inspired by Petra, with floor-to-ceiling city views, AWAY Spa and a seasonal rooftop WET Deck
best_for: Travelers who want a design-led base in Al Abdali for exploring Amman
Spa-goers who want Dead Sea product treatments in the city

facts.text: AWAY Spa offers facials with Dead Sea products, plus a steam room and jacuzzi.
AWAY Spa has separate sections for men and women and a couples suite.
Rooms have floor-to-ceiling views of the city skyline.
Pillows in the rooms portray Amman's culture.
Rooms have the signature W bed and a pillow menu.
The hotel is in the heart of Al Abdali.
Nearby sights include the Roman Theatre, the Citadel, Rainbow Street and The Boulevard.
W Insiders put together personalized itineraries.
Ensō serves Pan-Asian cuisine across two floors.

highlights.text: Guests enter through a canyon walk inspired by the ancient city of Petra.
The entrance features Bedouin fabrics shaped into a Sahabi tree in bold W colors.
The rooftop WET Deck has a mural by Dina Saadi that fuses traditional fabrics, floral lines and Islamic geometric patterns.
WET Deck is a seasonal rooftop bar with panoramic city views and live DJ sets.
The Penthouse I Suite has a bar area, a pool table and a private mini gym.

considerations.text: Parking is by valet; there is no self-parking.
The WET outdoor pool is seasonal.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may lack a traditional Middle Eastern feel.
